analytic_target.statement: Prove C_tot<=Q X^epsilon, or compile the exported injective ray web into an original transport seed.

claim_boundary: This artifact proves fixed-a ray uniqueness, cross-a injectivity, multiplicity versus primitive denominator, and dyadic web extraction. It proves no collision bound, transport seed, equal-height closure, full moment, density gain, or interval gain.

exact_replay.analytic_or_web: either C_tot<=Q*X^epsilon or a dyadic rational-ray web is exported; the web is not yet a transport seed
exact_replay.cross_a_injectivity: spacing Omega(D^-1) of exp(beta*a/D) and error O((KQ)^-1) prevent one label from serving distinct a
exact_replay.dyadic_extraction: C_tot collisions yield some dyadic M with >>C_tot/(M log Q) distinct a and injective labels q<<Q/M
exact_replay.gate: equal-height collision count or rational-ray web to E16
exact_replay.multiplicity_contract: class degree M implies primitive denominator q<<Q/M
exact_replay.same_a_rigidity: Farey spacing Omega(Q^-2) and error O((KQ)^-1) force one primitive rational label for each a

inverse_output.statement: C_tot collisions yield a dyadic multiplicity M, at least a constant times C_tot/(M log Q) distinct a values, and injective primitive labels of denominator O(Q/M).

prior_context.cycle90_role: supply the saddle collision relation and lower-band parameter margins

ray_rigidity.statement: All collisions at fixed a are multiples of one primitive rational ray, and distinct a values have distinct primitive labels.
